    *   Claiming life insurance benefits
    *   Obtaining death benefits from government programs (e.g., Social Security)
    *   Filing for probate
    *   Legal and statistical purposes

    *   Full name of the deceased
    *   Date and place of death
    *   Cause of death

    *   Marital status

    *   Informant's name and relationship to the deceased
